policy: Explicit patches applied to a separate publication text layer by tools/parse_source.py; source/Heraldry_RC484.md is never modified. Each patch closes one issue from production/qa/ambiguity-triage.json; author-authorized rules clarifications (2026-10-06 request: 'fix all the outstanding manuscript issues').
authorization: Project owner request, 2026-10-06, in the Claude Code session

patches.issue: A-04 (+ Tabletop equivalent): does a cone or line affect the combatant it originates from?
patches.find: Unless a rule says otherwise, a cone or line originates at the effect's source.
patches.replace: Unless a rule says otherwise, a cone or line originates at the effect's source and does not affect the combatant it originates from.

patches.issue: A-19: Impassable Terrain 'provides Cover' vs terrain table 'Chasms and pits ... provide no Cover'
patches.find: It provides **Cover**. It does not block **LOS**. A combatant may **Jump** over an **Impassable Terrain** feature
patches.replace: It provides **Cover** unless its terrain entry says otherwise. It does not block **LOS**. A combatant may **Jump** over an **Impassable Terrain** feature

patches.issue: A-07, A-08, A-09: unstated deployment edge pair, depth, corner-zone size and placement order
patches.find: 11. **Deploy the Parties.** Resolve deployment exactly as the scenario instructs.
patches.replace: 11. **Deploy the Parties.** Resolve deployment exactly as the scenario instructs. Where the scenario is silent, the **Setup Roll-off** winner chooses their battlefield edge or corner zone and the other party takes the opposite one; each zone extends **6"** from its edge, a corner zone is **8"×8"**, and parties alternate placing Heroes, starting with the party that lost the **Setup Roll-off**.

patches.issue: A-02: 'central Standing Stone' undefined for three Stones in a triangle
patches.find: Place the Antlered Warden adjacent to the central Standing Stone when the first Stone is Interacted with.
patches.replace: When a Hero first Interacts with a Standing Stone, place the Antlered Warden adjacent to that Stone.

patches.issue: A-03: 'at the perimeter of the Central Clearing, 4" from its edge' is self-contradictory
patches.find: Place at the perimeter of the Central Clearing, **4"** from its edge.
patches.replace: Place inside the Central Clearing, **4"** from its edge.

patches.issue: A-18: which Monster group goes to which Monster Entry marker
patches.find: at the **3 Monster Entry** markers, one complete group per marker.
patches.replace: at the **3 Monster Entry** markers, one complete group per marker, assigned at random.

patches.issue: A-01: Satchel 'at the battlefield centre' yet 'adjacent to the centre ruin' (A.2/A.4 govern)
patches.find: | **Dispatch Satchel** | At the battlefield centre, adjacent to the centre ruin. |
patches.replace: | **Dispatch Satchel** | Adjacent to the centre ruin. |
